title: Redlined and disconnected: Historic housing discrimination and modern-day energy insecurity disparities in Minnesota's Twin Cities
Real-Time Energy Transitions from the Inside: Perspectives of a Large Utility Implementing Energy Transition Projects
A Novel Approach to Stimulate Snow Loss on Photovoltaic Production
How can we study technology spillovers and their impact on clean energy innovation?
Pathways to Community Agency and Ownership of Energy Systems: An Application to Shared Solar Systems
Regulatory Capture in State Public Utility Commissions
Sharing the Sun: Community Solar Market Status and Trends
Institutions, in time: Designing feedback pathways for shared infrastructure transitions
Ratemaking for the Mid-transition: An Example of the Social Construction of Electric System Prices from Community Shared Solar
abstract: Electric utility rates are usually presented to consumers as reflecting costs or market efficiency. But we argue that utility rates and prices are more than they seem: they are socially constructed, formed from deeply held institutional logics. Working with 104 community shared solar (CSS) subscription contracts across 33 utility programs in Minnesota, we examine the rhetoric over cross-subsidy and ‘paying a fair share,’ showing the construction of utility costs, benefits, and values of these programs. We develop a financial model, apply archival research, and use ethnographic methods to analyze how these electricity system prices of CSS are constructed. We use a framework of embedded, short-run incremental, and long-run incremental institutional logics, demonstrating that if advocates and energy transition researchers are to take clean energy deployment, innovation, and equity seriously, they need more education, transparency, and communication around these logics and their effect on prices. We argue that with a better shared understanding of how electricity prices form, we can take responsibility for our imagined constraints and create electricity prices that can navigate the transition’s phase-in and phase-out activities toward collective, long-term benefit.
abstract_zh: 过渡期的费率制定：电力系统价格社会建构的一个案例。电力公用事业费率通常被呈现给消费者，被认为反映了成本或市场效率。但我们认为，公用事业费率和价格的内涵远不止于此：它们是社会建构的产物，由根深蒂固的制度逻辑所形成。通过考察明尼苏达州 33 个公用事业计划中的 104 份社区共享太阳能（CSS）认购合同，我们研究了围绕交叉补贴和“公平承担份额”的话语，展示了这些计划中公用事业成本、收益和价值的建构过程。我们构建了一个财务模型，运用档案研究，并采用民族志方法，分析这些社区共享太阳能电力系统价格是如何被建构的。我们借助嵌入式、短期增量式和长期增量式制度逻辑的框架，论证了如果倡导者和能源转型研究者要认真对待清洁能源的推广、创新与公平，就需要围绕这些逻辑及其对价格的影响开展更多教育、提高透明度并加强沟通。我们认为，只有对电价形成机制有更深入的共同理解，我们才能为自身想象中的约束承担责任，并制定出能够引导转型的分阶段推进与退出活动、实现集体长期利益的电价。

title: Reckoning with Social Policy in Utility Regulation
A framework and methodology for analyzing technology spillover processes with an application in solar photovoltaics
abstract: Technology spillovers, understood as knowledge flows across technology domains, are an important mechanism for innovation, as progress in one technology area can lead to unexpected benefits in other technology areas. Despite the importance of technology spillovers in theories of recombinant innovation, significant gaps remain in our understanding of how spillovers across knowledge domains occur, what factors enable or affect spillovers, or how much consideration should be given to technology spillovers in research and innovation policy and management. In this paper, we develop and demonstrate novel conceptual and methodological tools to address these knowledge gaps. Specifically, we introduce a conceptual framework that views technology spillovers as a dynamic process of micro-level knowledge transfer across technological domains that drives recombinant innovation in a knowledge-receiving domain. We use this framework to develop a process-tracing methodology for identifying and analyzing individual micro-level technology spillovers. We demonstrate the application of our framework and methodology in a case of three important innovations in crystalline silicon solar photovoltaics by reconstructing a detailed history of how technology spillovers have played a critical role in enabling and driving these three innovations over time. We show how our approach generates important insights relevant to public policy and R&D management that aim to harness spillovers for accelerating innovation.
abstract_zh: 分析技术溢出过程的框架与方法：以太阳能光伏为例的应用。技术溢出被理解为跨技术领域的知识流动，是创新的重要机制，因为一个技术领域的进步可以在其他技术领域带来意想不到的益处。尽管技术溢出在重组式创新理论中占有重要地位，但我们对跨知识领域溢出如何发生、哪些因素促进或影响溢出，以及在研究与创新政策和管理中应给予技术溢出多大的考虑，仍存在明显的认识空白。本文提出了新的概念和方法工具，以填补这些空白。具体而言，我们提出了一个概念框架，将技术溢出视为跨技术领域微观层面知识转移的动态过程，这一过程推动了知识接收领域的重组式创新。我们运用该框架发展了一种过程追踪方法，用于识别和分析个体微观层面的技术溢出。我们以晶体硅太阳能光伏领域的三项重要创新为案例，展示了该框架与方法的应用，通过重建详细的历史过程，说明技术溢出如何在长时间内促成并推动这三项创新。我们表明，该方法能够为旨在利用溢出效应加速创新的公共政策和研发管理提供重要见解。

title: Minnesota's energy paradox: Household energy insecurity in the face of racial and economic disparities
Processes of power: Transitions and justice of energy infrastructure in Minnesota
'Cooperative is an Oxymoron!': A Polycentric Energy Transition Perspective on Distributed Energy Deployment in the Upper Midwestern United States
Regulating for Energy Justice
The Grassroots Are Always Greener: Community-Based Organizations as Innovators of Shared Solar Energy in the United States
Comparing and Contrasting the Institutional Relationships, Regulatory Frameworks, and Energy System Governance of European and U.S. Electric Cooperatives
abstract: Energy democracy brings attention to the role of institutional relationships and regulatory frameworks. The movement frames individuals and communities as central actors and highlights the potential for electric cooperatives and civic organizations to enable low-carbon energy transitions and social empowerment. The history of cooperatives dates to the mid-nineteenth century when they began forming around shared principles, including democratic member control, local autonomy, cooperation, and concern for community. However, in practice, cooperatives face different contexts and distinct opportunities for furthering energy democracy. Over the past decade, energy democracy has emerged most prominently in Europe and the United States where cooperatives share many experiences but also exhibit critical differences. Europe has experienced growth of newly forming renewable energy cooperatives, many with the aim of challenging the legacy energy system. In contrast, US cooperatives coevolved with fossil fuel resources and became embedded within large-scale, centralized infrastructure. The long-term institutional relationships among US cooperatives are being disrupted as distributed renewable energy resources are being integrated into this legacy system. These differences in history and emerging forms of energy system governance present a different picture of ownership, control, and autonomy between American and European cooperatives.
abstract_zh: 比较与对照制度关系、监管框架与能源民主：美国与欧洲的合作社。能源民主关注制度关系与监管框架的作用。该运动将个人和社区视为核心行动者，并强调电力合作社与公民组织在推动低碳能源转型和社会赋权方面的潜力。合作社的历史可追溯至十九世纪中叶，当时它们围绕民主的成员控制、地方自治、合作以及对社区的关怀等共同原则开始组建。然而在实践中，合作社面临着不同的情境，并拥有推动能源民主的不同机遇。过去十年间，能源民主在欧洲和美国最为突出，两地合作社既有诸多共同经验，也表现出关键差异。欧洲新成立的可再生能源合作社不断增多，其中许多旨在挑战传统能源体系。相比之下，美国合作社与化石燃料资源共同演化，并嵌入大规模集中式基础设施之中。随着分布式可再生能源被整合进这一既有体系，美国合作社之间长期形成的制度关系正受到冲击。历史背景以及能源系统治理形式的新变化，揭示了美国与欧洲合作社在所有权、控制权和自治权方面的不同图景。

title: Cooperative Clean Energy
abstract: The last decade has seen significant attention and debate among academics, policymakers, and the broader public about how to accelerate the “clean energy transition” in the United States. Legal academics have made valuable contributions to the literature in this field, developing a rich body of scholarship on a broad range of legal, policy, economic, and technological aspects of the clean energy transition. But this scholarship has for the most part ignored the role of rural electric cooperatives, which serve 15% of U.S. electricity consumers. This scholarship gap has important implications. Rural electric cooperatives, first created by local communities in the United States in the early part of the twentieth century to electrify rural America, now exclusively serve over half of the U.S. landmass. As such, these cooperatives are positioned to be key players in building land-intensive renewable energy resources and expanding the electric grid. And while cooperatives today own and operate fewer coal-fired power plants than they have in decades past, as not-for-profit entities, the drivers for cooperatives to retire existing carbon-intensive power plants and build new clean energy are fundamentally different than the drivers for other actors in the electricity sector shaped by profit motives. Understanding these differences is critical to avoid leaving rural America with billions of dollars of stranded assets that struggle to compete against low-cost clean energy. In this Article, we draw on the structure and foundational principles underlying the cooperative form itself to offer a framework for rural electric cooperatives to thrive in the clean energy transition. Notably, the proposals we develop in this Article do not primarily rely on imposing new federal or state clean energy mandates on cooperatives, as has been the focus of the limited legal scholarship that exists to date. The long history of Congress and state legislatures allowing cooperatives to “self-regulate” makes exclusive reliance on such mandates a limited solution at best. Instead, we draw on the seven “Cooperative Principles” that govern all cooperatives—open and voluntary membership; democratic member control; members’ economic participation; autonomy and independence; education, training, and information; cooperation among cooperatives; and concern for community. Emphasis on these principles allows cooperatives to engage in the clean energy transition in a way that builds on their history and foundational principles as self-help organizations controlled by their members. Such an approach also recognizes the foundational role of member control within cooperatives, which has the potential to inform broader calls for increasing democratic accountability and racial and gender equity within the clean energy transition.
abstract_zh: 合作社与清洁能源。过去十年间，学术界、政策制定者和广大公众对如何加快美国“清洁能源转型”进行了大量关注和辩论。法律学者为该领域的文献做出了宝贵贡献，就清洁能源转型的诸多法律、政策、经济和技术层面发展了丰富的学术成果。然而，这些研究大多忽视了农村电力合作社的作用，而这类合作社为全美 15% 的电力消费者提供服务。这一研究空白具有重要影响。农村电力合作社由美国地方社区于二十世纪初为农村地区通电而首创，如今其服务范围已覆盖全美超过一半的国土面积。因此，这些合作社有望成为建设土地密集型可再生能源资源和扩展电网的关键力量。尽管如今合作社拥有和运营的燃煤电厂数量少于过去几十年，但作为非营利性实体，合作社退役现有高碳电厂、建设新清洁能源的驱动因素，与受利润动机驱动的电力行业其他参与者截然不同。理解这些差异对于避免农村美国因无法与低成本清洁能源竞争而承受数十亿美元的搁浅资产至关重要。在本文中，我们借鉴合作社形式本身的结构和基本原则，为农村电力合作社在清洁能源转型中实现繁荣提供了一个框架。值得注意的是，本文提出的建议并不主要依赖于对合作社强加新的联邦或州清洁能源强制性规定，而这正是迄今为数不多的法律文献所关注的焦点。国会和州立法机构长期允许合作社“自我监管”，因此完全依赖此类强制性规定充其量只是一个有限的解决方案。相反，我们借鉴了统御所有合作社的七项“合作社原则”：开放且自愿的成员资格；民主的成员控制；成员的经济参与；自主与独立；教育、培训与信息；合作社之间的合作；以及对社区的关怀。强调这些原则，使合作社能够以一种建立在其历史与基本原则之上的方式参与清洁能源转型，这些合作社是由其成员控制的自助组织。这一路径也承认了成员控制在合作社中的基础性作用，这有可能为在清洁能源转型中加强民主问责以及种族与性别平等的更广泛呼吁提供参考。

title: A Dynamic Approach for Identifying Technological Breakthroughs with an Application in Solar Photovoltaics
A Review of Barriers in Implementing Dynamic Electricity Pricing to Achieve Cost-Causality
abstract: Rapidly changing economics, customer preferences, and policy to address climate change and local environmental pollutants have driven increased deployment of a wide range of distributed energy resources in the U.S. electricity system. Distributed energy resources have enabled an expanded role for energy consumers and non-utility third parties to reshape system costs, drawing renewed attention to the potential of reforming electricity rate design based on the further application of cost-causal principals to improve overall system fairness and efficiency. One mechanism to move toward greater application of cost-causal rate design is dynamic pricing, which varies electricity prices across time and location to reflect costs of providing electricity to consumers under specific market conditions and grid operation conditions. While dynamic electricity pricing has penetrated some markets, and it has not been widely implemented, particularly for residential consumers. In this review article, we provide a brief summary of electricity rate design, including the possibility of introducing dynamic prices, and explain why dynamic prices are more reflective of the short-run marginal costs of electricity supply than volumetric rates. We then explore the barriers to the widespread adoption of residential dynamic pricing, emphasizing technical, economic, and political challenges. Our assessment reflects the ability of dynamic prices to engender more equitable and efficient outcomes by achieving the goal of cost-causality, and we argue that a move toward more dynamic pricing can constitute a welfare improvement over volumetric rates. However, dynamic pricing does not completely address the full set of challenges associated with rate design and, alone, is unlikely to enable the full recovery of fixed costs and the fair attribution of the positive and negative externalities of electricity provision. Therefore, electricity rate design requires tradeoffs, making it as much an art as a science. This analysis synthesizes literature across multiple fields and suggests avenues for further research.
abstract_zh: 经济形势、客户偏好以及应对气候变化和地方环境污染物的政策快速变化，推动了美国电力系统中各类分布式能源资源的广泛部署。分布式能源资源使能源消费者和非公用事业第三方得以发挥更大作用，重塑系统成本，并使人们重新关注通过进一步应用成本因果原则改革电价设计的潜力，以提高系统整体的公平性和效率。实现成本因果型电价设计的一种途径是动态定价，即按时间和地点变动电价，以反映在特定市场条件和电网运行条件下向消费者提供电力的成本。尽管动态电价已进入部分市场，但它尚未被广泛实施，尤其是在居民用户中。在本综述文章中，我们简要概述了电价设计，包括引入动态价格的可能性，并解释了为何动态价格比按用量计价的电价更能反映电力供应的短期边际成本。随后，我们探讨了居民动态定价广泛普及的障碍，重点关注技术、经济和政治方面的挑战。我们的评估表明，动态价格能够通过实现成本因果性这一目标，带来更加公平、高效的结果；我们认为，向更多的动态定价转型相对于按用量计价的电价，可构成福利改善。然而，动态定价并不能完全解决电价设计所面临的全部挑战，单靠它不太可能实现固定成本的全额回收，也不能公平地分摊电力供应的正外部性和负外部性。因此，电价设计需要权衡取舍，它既是一门艺术，也是一门科学。本分析综合了多个领域的文献，并提出了进一步研究的方向。

title: Municipal Utilities and Electric Cooperatives in the United States: Interpretive Frames, Strategic Actions, and Place-Specific Transitions
Solar Photovoltaic Interventions Have Reduced Rural Poverty in China
abstract: Since 2013, China has implemented a large-scale initiative to systematically deploy solar photovoltaic (PV) projects to alleviate poverty in rural areas. To provide new understanding of China’s targeted poverty alleviation strategy, we use a panel dataset of 211 pilot counties that received targeted PV investments from 2013 to 2016, and find that the PV poverty alleviation pilot policy increases per-capita disposable income in a county by approximately 7%-8%. The effect of PV investment is positive and significant in the year of policy implementation and the effect is more than twice as high in the subsequent two to three years. The PV poverty alleviation effect is stronger in poorer regions, particularly in Eastern China. Our results are robust to alternative specifications and variable definitions. We propose several policy recommendations to sustain progress in China’s efforts to deploy PV for poverty alleviation.
abstract_zh: 太阳能光伏干预措施降低了中国的农村贫困。自 2013 年以来，中国实施了一项大规模倡议，系统性地部署太阳能光伏（PV）项目，以缓解农村地区的贫困。为了深入理解中国精准扶贫战略，我们利用 2013 年至 2016 年间接受精准光伏投资的 211 个试点县的面板数据，发现光伏扶贫试点政策使县域人均可支配收入提高了约 7%–8%。光伏投资的效应在政策实施当年为正且显著，并且在随后的两至三年效应更是高出两倍以上。光伏扶贫效应在较贫困地区尤为显著，尤其是在中国东部。我们的结果在替代设定和变量定义下依然稳健。我们提出了若干政策建议，以维持中国利用光伏推进扶贫工作的成果。

title: International Climate Change Policy
abstract: International cooperation to address the threat of climate change has become more institutionally diverse over the past decade, reflecting multiple scales of governance and the growing inclusion of climate change issues in other policy arenas. Cooperation under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change has continued to evolve from the 1997 Kyoto Protocol to the 2015 Paris Agreement, while other governmental and private sector international fora for cooperation have arisen. As the level of activity in international cooperation on climate change mitigation has increased, so too has the related scholarly literature. In this review, we synthesize the literature on international climate change cooperation and identify key policy implications, as well as those findings most relevant for the research community. Our scope includes critical evaluation of the organization and implementation of agreements and instruments, retrospective analysis of cooperative efforts, and explanations of successes and failures.
abstract_zh: 过去十年间，应对气候变化威胁的国际合作在制度上日益多样化，这反映了治理的多层次性，以及气候变化问题在其他政策领域中日益增长的纳入。《联合国气候变化框架公约》下的合作不断演进，从1997年的《京都议定书》发展到2015年的《巴黎协定》，同时，其他政府间和私营部门的国际合作论坛也相继出现。随着气候变化减缓国际合作活动水平的提高，相关的学术文献也随之增多。在本综述中，我们对国际气候变化合作的文献进行了综合，并指出了关键的政策含义，以及与研究界最为相关的发现。我们的范围包括：对协议与工具的组织和实施进行批判性评估，对合作努力的回顾性分析，以及对成功与失败的解释。

title: Why Is China's Wind Power Generation Not Living up to Its Potential?
abstract: Following a decade of unprecedented investment, China now has the world's largest installed base of wind power capacity. Yet, despite siting most wind farms in the wind-rich Northern and Western provinces, electricity generation from Chinese wind farms has not reached the performance benchmarks of the United States and many other advanced economies. This has resulted in lower environmental, economic, and health benefits than anticipated. We develop a framework to explain the performance of the Chinese and US wind sectors, accounting for a comprehensive set of driving factors. We apply this framework to a novel dataset of virtually all wind farms installed in China and the United States through the end of 2013. We first estimate the wind sector's technical potential using a methodology that produces consistent estimates for both countries. We compare this potential to actual performance and find that Chinese wind farms generated electricity at 37%–45% of their annual technical potential during 2006–2013 compared to 54%–61% in the United States. Our findings underscore that the larger gap between actual performance and technical potential in China compared to the United States is significantly driven by delays in grid connection (14% of the gap) and curtailment due to constraints in grid management (10% of the gap), two challenges of China's wind power expansion covered extensively in the literature. However, our findings show that China's underperformance is also driven by suboptimal turbine model selection (31% of the gap), wind farm siting (23% of the gap), and turbine hub heights (6% of the gap)—factors that have received less attention in the literature and, crucially, are locked-in for the lifetime of wind farms. This suggests that besides addressing grid connection delays and curtailment, China will also need policy measures to address turbine siting and technology choices to achieve its national goals and increase utilization up to US levels.
abstract_zh: 为何中国的风力发电未能充分发挥其潜力？经过十年空前的投资，中国如今拥有世界上规模最大的风电装机容量。然而，尽管中国大部分风电场都建在风能资源丰富的北方和西部省份，中国风电场的发电表现仍未达到美国及其他发达经济体的绩效基准。这导致其所带来的环境、经济和健康效益低于预期。我们构建了一个框架，用以解释中美两国风电行业的发电表现，该框架涵盖了一整套全面的驱动因素。我们将此框架应用于一个新的数据集，该数据集几乎涵盖了截至 2013 年底中美两国安装的所有风电场。我们首先采用一种能够为两国产生一致估计结果的方法，估算风电行业的技术潜力。我们将这一潜力与实际发电表现进行比较，发现 2006 年至 2013 年间，中国风电场的年发电量仅为其技术潜力的 37%–45%，而美国则为 54%–61%。我们的研究结果表明，与美国相比，中国实际表现与技术潜力之间更大的差距，主要受到并网延迟（占差距的 14%）以及电网管理约束导致的弃风（占差距的 10%）的显著影响，这两项挑战在文献中已得到广泛讨论。然而，我们的研究结果还表明，中国的表现不佳也受到以下因素的驱动：次优的风机机型选择（占差距的 31%）、风电场选址（占差距的 23%）以及风机轮毂高度（占差距的 6%）——这些因素在文献中较少受到关注，而且关键在于，它们在风电场的整个生命周期内都会被锁定。这表明，除了解决并网延迟和弃风问题外，中国还需要政策措施来解决风电场选址和技术选择问题，才能实现其国家目标，并将利用率提高到美国的水平。

title: Design Choices and Equity Implications of Community Shared Solar
Six principles for energy innovation
Making Technological Innovation Work for Sustainable Development
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Sustainable development requires harnessing technological innovation to improve human well-being in current and future generations. However, poor, marginalized, and unborn populations too often lack the economic or political power to shape innovation processes to meet their needs. Issues arise at all stages of innovation, from invention of a technology through its selection, production, adaptation, adoption, and retirement. Three insights should inform efforts to intervene in innovation systems for sustainable development. First, innovation is not a linear process but rather a complex adaptive system involving many actors and institutions operating simultaneously from local to global levels; interventions must take this complexity into account. Second, there has been significant experimentation in mobilizing technology for sustainable development in the health, energy, and agriculture sectors, among others, but learning from past experience requires structured cross-sectoral comparisons and recognition of the socio-technical nature of innovation. Third, the current constellation of rules, norms, and incentives shaping innovation is not always aligned towards sustainable development. Past experience demonstrates that it is possible to reform these institutions, and the imperative of harnessing innovation for sustainable development makes it necessary to do so. Many actors have the power to re-orient innovation systems towards sustainable development through research, advocacy, training, convening, policymaking, and financing. We offer three proposals to begin: mobilizing global financing to invest in inventing suitable and affordable technologies to meet sustainable development objectives; developing measures to engage marginalized populations systematically through all stages of the innovation process; and establishing channels for regularized learning across domains of practice.
abstract_zh: 让技术创新服务于可持续发展。可持续发展要求利用技术创新来改善当代和未来世代的人类福祉。然而，贫困、边缘化和尚未出生的人群往往缺乏经济或政治力量来塑造创新过程，以满足他们的需求。创新的各个阶段都会出现问题，从技术的发明，到其选择、生产、适应、采用直至退役。有三点洞见应当指导干预创新体系以促进可持续发展的努力。第一，创新并非线性过程，而是一个复杂的适应性系统，涉及从地方到全球层面同时运行的众多行动者和制度；干预措施必须考虑到这种复杂性。第二，在卫生、能源和农业等部门，动员技术促进可持续发展已经进行了大量实验，但要从过去的经验中学习，需要进行结构化的跨部门比较，并认识到创新的社会技术属性。第三，目前塑造创新的规则、规范和激励机制的组合，并不总是与可持续发展的方向保持一致。过去的经验表明，改革这些制度是可能的，而利用创新促进可持续发展的紧迫性使得这样做变得十分必要。许多行动者都有能力通过研究、倡导、培训、召集、政策制定和融资，将创新体系重新导向可持续发展。我们提出三项初步建议：动员全球融资，投资于发明适宜且可负担的技术，以满足可持续发展目标；制定措施，使边缘化群体在创新过程的各个阶段得到系统性参与；建立跨领域常态化学习的渠道。

title: Reforming the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change's Assessment of Climate Economics
The Pressing Energy Innovation Challenge of the U.S. National Labs
Evaluating Renewable Portfolio Standards for In-State Renewable Deployment: Accounting for Policy Heterogeneity
abstract: Renewable portfolio standards (RPS) are the most common state-level policies for promoting renewable electricity in the United States. State RPS policies are heterogeneously designed, particularly with respect to their use of flexibility mechanisms that allow obligations to be met with renewable energy generated in other states. However, the renewable energy that is produced within an RPS-enacting state itself is of high political importance, making in-state renewable energy deployment an important evaluation metric for RPS policies. In this paper, we develop a novel dataset of state-level RPS policies and renewable energy deployment. We show that failing to effectively limit comparisons to similarly designed RPS policies may lead to the misperception that more stringent RPS policies do not necessarily lead to higher renewable deployment. We then show that after controlling for specific policy design features, states with more stringent RPS policies tend to have greater in-state renewable energy deployment. Specifically, we find that a 1 percentage point increase in the stringency of an RPS policy is associated with a 0.28-0.29 percentage point increase in the share of in-state renewable electricity capacity. Articulate modeling of policy variety has been largely lacking from past studies and is essential for accurate econometric analysis of heterogeneous energy policies.
abstract_zh: 评估可再生能源配额制对州内可再生能源部署的影响：考虑政策设计的差异。可再生能源配额制（RPS）是美国促进可再生电力发展最普遍的州级政策。各州的RPS政策设计差异很大，尤其体现在其灵活机制的使用上，这些机制允许以其他州生产的可再生能源来履行义务。然而，在实施RPS的州内生产的可再生能源本身具有高度的政治重要性，这使得州内可再生能源部署成为评估RPS政策的重要指标。在本文中，我们构建了一个关于州级RPS政策和可再生能源部署的新数据集。我们表明，如果未能有效地将比较限定在设计相似的RPS政策之内，可能会导致一种误解，即更严格的RPS政策不一定带来更高的可再生能源部署。随后，在控制了具体的政策设计特征后，我们发现RPS政策更为严格的州，其州内可再生电力装机容量占比往往更高。具体而言，我们发现RPS政策严格度每提高 1 个百分点，与州内可再生电力装机容量占比提高 0.28–0.29 个百分点相关。以往研究在很大程度上缺乏对政策多样性的精细建模，而这对于准确计量分析异质性能源政策而言至关重要。

title: Expanding and Better Targeting U.S. Investment in Energy Innovation: An Analytical Approach
abstract: In Chapter 1 we describe the urgent challenges posed by the current U.S. energy system and make the case that accelerated innovation in energy technologies will be essential in meeting these challenges. In this chapter, we explore the question of determining the appropriate role for the U.S. government in fostering energy innovation. This is a complex issue because the U.S. energy system encompasses many functions (e.g., invention and discovery, R&D spillovers, economies of scale, clustering, learning by doing, deployment, etc.); government actions to facilitate innovation interact with private actors in many markets; there are a multiplicity of actors (e.g., national and regional public organizations, private firms, universities, consumers); there is deep uncertainty in future technology performance rooted in many factors (e.g., the rate of technological change, economic growth, energy prices, consumer adoption, etc.). In this book we take a systems approach to the innovation process. The chapter starts by focusing on selected key government functions, and in Chapter 6, we integrate the analysis from this chapter with analysis and holistic recommendations that cut across the entire system. Our analysis in this chapter starts with the energy research, development, and demonstration (RD&D) investments of the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) – the single largest public funder of energy RD&D in the United States. Despite the broader scope of DOE's jurisdiction, which we trace to its historical roots, we limit our analysis to only the department's energy RD&D funding activities. After describing DOE's current role investing in energy RD&D, we analyze how DOE makes decisions about its energy RD&D investments. We argue that a method to inform public energy RD&D funding decisions that allows for an integrated, consistent, and transparent analysis among competing technology areas is needed.
abstract_zh: 扩大并更好地定向美国能源创新投资：一种分析方法。第一章阐述了当前美国能源系统所面临的紧迫挑战，并论证了加速能源技术创新对于应对这些挑战至关重要。在本章中，我们探讨了美国政府在促进能源创新中应发挥何种适当作用的问题。这是一个复杂的问题，因为美国能源系统涵盖众多功能（例如发明与发现、研发溢出、规模经济、产业集聚、干中学、部署等）；政府促进创新的行动与众多市场中的私人行动者相互作用；行动者众多（例如国家和地区公共机构、私营企业、大学、消费者）；未来技术表现存在深层次的不确定性，其根源在于诸多因素（例如技术进步速度、经济增长、能源价格、消费者采用等）。在本书中，我们对创新过程采用系统性方法。本章首先聚焦于若干关键政府职能，而在第六章中，我们将把本章的分析与贯穿整个系统的综合性分析和整体性建议整合起来。本章的分析始于美国能源部（DOE）的能源研究、开发与示范（RD&D）投资——能源部是美国最大的公共能源研发资助机构。尽管能源部的管辖范围更为广泛，我们追溯了其历史渊源，但本章的分析仅限于该部门的能源研发资助活动。在描述能源部当前在能源研发投资中的角色之后，我们分析了该部门如何对其能源研发投资做出决策。我们认为，需要一种方法来为公共能源研发资金决策提供依据，该方法应能在相互竞争的技术领域之间实现综合、一致且透明的分析。

title: The Canadian Oil Sands Industry Under Carbon Constraints
The SO2 Allowance-Trading System and the Clean Air Act Amendments of 1990: Reflections on 20 Years of Policy Innovation
What Drives States to Support Renewable Energy?
abstract:
Why do states support electricity generation from renewable energy sources? Lyon/Yin (2010), Chandler (2009), and Huang et al. (2007) have answered this question for the adoption of renewable portfolio standards (RPS) at the U.S. state level. This article supplements their work by testing the core hypotheses on the EU27 sample between 1990 and 2010. Furthermore, the article asks why the majority of EU states rely on feed-in-tariffs (FIT). The study conducts logistic time series cross-section regression analyses that run on a hazard model.
Evidence in support of private interest theory and public interest theory is provided. (a) The existence of a solar energy association increases the probability of a state to adopt regulation. (b) Solar radiation, and(c) the unemployment rate also increase the odds. (d) Electricity market concentration decreases the probability of transition.
abstract_zh:
是什么驱动各州支持可再生能源？为何各州要支持利用可再生能源源头发电？Lyon/Yin（2010）、Chandler（2009）以及 Huang 等人（2007）已经针对美国各州采用可再生能源配额制（RPS）的情况回答了这一问题。本文通过在 1990 年至 2010 年的欧盟 27 国样本上检验其核心假设，对他们的工作做出补充。此外，本文还探讨了为什么大多数欧盟国家依赖上网电价补贴（FIT）。本研究采用逻辑时间序列截面回归分析，并基于风险模型进行估计。
研究结果为私人利益理论和公共利益理论提供了证据支持。(a) 太阳能协会的存在提高了一个州采纳监管措施的概率。(b) 太阳辐射量和 (c) 失业率同样提高了采纳的可能性。(d) 电力市场集中度降低了政策转变的概率。

title: Energy R&D Portfolio Analysis Based on Climate Change Mitigation
Expert Elicitation of Cost, Performance, and RD&D Budgets for Coal Power with CCS
abstract: There is uncertainty about the ex-ante returns to research, development, and demonstration programs in the United States on carbon capture and sequestration (CCS) technology. To quantify this uncertainty, we conducted a written expert elicitation of thirteen experts in fossil power and CCS technologies from the government, academia, and the private sector. We asked experts to provide their recommended budget and allocation of RD&D funds by specific fossil power and CCS technology and type of RD&D activity (i.e. basic research, applied research, pilot plants, and demonstration plants) for the United States. The elicitation instrument was structured around estimating the cost and performance of coal-fired power plants with and without CCS in the years 2010 and 2030 under four funding scenarios for federal fossil energy RD&D in the USA. The most important areas identified for basic research were chemical looping combustion and membrane technology. The most important area for commercial demonstration was integrated gasification combined cycle (IGCC). There was substantial disagreement between experts on both the current and future capital cost to build a new coal-fired power plant with CCS. There was also disagreement across experts as to whether the capital cost of a new coal plant with CCS would increase or decrease if federal RD&D funding stayed constant at current levels. However, there was a consensus among our experts that accelerated federal RD&D would (weakly) lower the capital cost requirements for a new coal plant with CCS. On average, experts estimated that if their recommended RD&D portfolio was implemented, the capital cost of new coal plants with CCS in 2030 would decrease by 10% in addition to the cost reductions/increases that would occur by 2030 through non-public RD&D related factors.
abstract_zh: 燃煤发电配备碳捕集与封存（CCS）的成本、性能及研发预算的专家征询。美国针对碳捕集与封存（CCS）技术的研究、开发与示范（RD&D）项目的事前回报存在不确定性。为量化这一不确定性，我们对来自政府、学术界和私营部门、专长于化石能源发电和 CCS 技术的 13 位专家进行了书面专家征询。我们要求专家针对美国，提出其建议的研发资金预算，以及按具体化石发电与 CCS 技术和研发活动类型（即基础研究、应用研究、中试装置和示范装置）进行的资金分配。该征询工具围绕估算 2010 年和 2030 年，在美国联邦化石能源研发资金四种情景下，配备与不配备 CCS 的燃煤电厂的成本与性能而设计。基础研究中最重要的领域被认为是化学链燃烧和膜技术。商业示范中最重要的领域是整体煤气化联合循环（IGCC）。专家们在建设配备 CCS 的新燃煤电厂的当前及未来资本成本问题上存在重大分歧。关于如果联邦研发资金维持在当前水平，配备 CCS 的新燃煤电厂的资本成本会上升还是下降，专家之间也存在分歧。然而，专家们对于加速联邦研发投入将（在一定程度上）降低配备 CCS 的新燃煤电厂的资本成本需求，已形成共识。平均而言，专家估计，若实施其建议的研发组合，到 2030 年配备 CCS 的新燃煤电厂的资本成本将比仅因非公共研发相关因素而发生的成本下降/上升额外下降 10%。
